subject: Final Reminder: Complete your profile to claim your C Programming certificate!
message:
Dear Student,
This is a final reminder from Coding Club CUH regarding the C Programming Course.
To be eligible to receive your certificate, you must complete your profile and formally enroll in the course. Please log in and complete these steps immediately to avoid missing out.
https://codingclubcuh.online

Regards,
Coding Club Team
Central University of Haryana
